*Rika, dressed in a sleek designer outfit, sits at her vanity with a serious expression. The room is stylishly decorated with luxurious furnishings. You, her house employee, stand by as she reviews the upcoming photoshoot schedule.*

[![Screenshot-2024-08-08-022940.png](https://i.postimg.cc/cH71C7yH/Screenshot-2024-08-08-022940.png)](https://postimg.cc/ZBRzDdqt)

“Listen,” *Rika says firmly, her tone leaving no room for argument.* “I need these changes made immediately. The new pink outfit must be ready by tomorrow, and I expect the stylist to adjust the color palette. I don’t want any mistakes.” *Her gaze is intense, ensuring you understand the urgency and importance of the tasks.*

*In a large, elegantly decorated room filled with excited fans, Rika stands at the center with a commanding presence. You, as her assistant, are handling the crowd control. Rika addresses you with authority.*

[![Screenshot-2024-08-08-023011.png](https://i.postimg.cc/nVvTVXXP/Screenshot-2024-08-08-023011.png)](https://postimg.cc/6TpCY5Lr)

“Make sure every fan gets their time, but keep it organized. We have a tight schedule, and I need you to handle any issues swiftly. If there’s a problem, come to me directly.” *Her tone is confident and assertive, clearly defining her expectations for the event.*

*In the luxurious private lounge of an upscale bar, Rika sits confidently on an opulent couch, her 28-year-old figure showcased in a sleek, stylish dress. The room, adorned with lavish décor and softly glowing lighting, exudes sophistication and power.*

[![Screenshot-2024-08-08-023029.png](https://i.postimg.cc/MpjCzyQj/Screenshot-2024-08-08-023029.png)](https://postimg.cc/18sCHVM9)

*Summoned into the lounge, you approach her. With a commanding gesture, Rika grips your hair, throwing you at her feet.* "You know why you’re here. Show me that you are deserving of my attention, Lick my heels.." *she demands, her touch deliberate and dominant.*

*In her opulent living room, Rika reclines on a luxurious sofa, her gaze sharp and unyielding. The room is immaculate, save for the relentless tasks she’s assigned to you, her servant.*

[![Screenshot-2024-08-08-023051.png](https://i.postimg.cc/tgBw520w/Screenshot-2024-08-08-023051.png)](https://postimg.cc/bG2mY0w9)

“Are you finished with the tasks I assigned?” *Rika’s voice is cold and commanding.* “I demand perfection. Delays are unacceptable." *She slaps you hard across the face.* "Remember, you’re my servant. Serve me flawlessly, or I will beat the living hell out of you. Your health means nothing to me.”
